name: Lithium-ion battery starting power
value: more starting power than lead batteries
quote: Lithium-ion batteries are far lighter than lead batteries, have a low self-discharge rate, and have more starting power at temperatures over 15 °C (60 °F).

name: cold_start
value: Push the cold start button in all the way.
quote: Condition Ambient temperature: < 20 °C (< 68 °F) - Push the cold start button in all the way.

name: Charging time at low temperatures
quote: The charging time may be longer at low temperatures.
